data: Each own pre-Jan1 snapshot only, filter origin entry_year >= start, retain row order and original clocks/censoring; unchanged 24 calendar-month training cap. No changed feature set or new vintages.
predictions: Save raw AJ and own-direct-parent unique-company shrinkage10; average three shrunk forecasts before metrics. No scaling or calibrator.

evaluation.top20: ceil(0.2*n) within each year; stable sample_id tie break; sum annual selected outcomes for pooled
evaluation.pooled: recompute on concatenated company predictions, no averaging annual AUC/AP
evaluation.intervals: 1000 original year-stratified company bootstrap indices seed2026110201; difference shortened minus2012; fixed predictions; undefined retained

checks.reference: 2012 trees and all native-time predictions must match saved C039 members exactly
checks.functions: train+evaluation all rows, all native times, both causes, explicit sum/reload<=1e-10
checks.sampling: paired seed and74 feature pools, bootstrap membership cannot be identical after companies removed
checks.independent: split-score,guard and direct-parent AJ replay; sklearn metrics and explicit pairs

reporting: All nine windows,seeds,annual and pooled results; complexity/support/cost. No per-year selection, automatic winner adoption, extra windows or fits. Fixed shrinking-history experiment, not global optimization.
limitations: 2023-2025 exposed; C039 seeds and74 list previously selected with exposed results. No new independent confirmation. Shortened history simultaneously changes sample size,event mix,bootstrap pool,training cuts and product-reference distribution,so cannot isolate policy causation.
compute: One 3-seed annual-window pilot; then26 independent tasks on oliver+lemon Slurm, n_jobs1, memory limit3GiB/task; no GPU algorithm. 2400s/task, preserve failures and recover publication without refitting.
privacy: Company arrays,predictions,models,thresholds,component details private; public code,configs,aggregate tables and hashes only.
